The '''Castle of Chivalry''' (Japanese: '''騎士道の館''' ''Hall of Chivalry'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location located in the [[Kalos]] region. [[Wikstrom]] of the [[Elite Four]] uses it to coach Pokémon and Trainers who desire true strength. It appeared in ''[[JN056|Searching for Chivalry!]]''.
[[File:Castle of Chivalry Medals.png|thumb|left|230px|Knight Medals]]
Upon learning of the Castle of Chivalry, {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] traveled there with {{AP|Farfetch'd}} and {{p|Scyther}}, respectively, to get some coaching from Wikstrom. The coaching session consists of three challenges: running ten laps around the castle, making it through a booby-trapped maze called the '''Labyrinth of Doubt''' (Japanese: '''不安的迷宫''' ''Maze of Doubts''), and fighting Wikstrom and his {{p|Aegislash}} while trying to retrieve a key from his {{p|Klefki}}. The Trainers and Pokémon who pass all three challenges are rewarded with Knight Medals.

Ash and Goh managed to pass the challenges and received Knight Medals. Afterwards, Wikstrom helped Goh [[Evolution|evolve]] his Scyther into {{TP|Goh|Scizor}} by giving it a [[Metal Coat]] and transferring it through a [[trade machine]].

The location was mentioned again in ''[[JN060|Beyond Chivalry… Aiming to be a Leek Master!]]'', where [[Rinto]] revealed that he and his {{p|Gallade}} had trained there as well.

In ''[[JN103|The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy!]]'', Wikstrom was seen having a brief battle with [[Drasna]] at the castle.
